title.zh: 轴对称圆电流丝稠密 Green 矩阵

summary: Evaluate separate flux and poloidal-field response columns for every weighted circular source at every cylindrical R-Z target point.

identity.relation: weighted circular filaments to per-source axisymmetric flux and poloidal-field response matrices
identity.direction: target [R,Z] rows and source [R,Z,weight] rows -> gpsi, gBR, gBZ matrices
identity.definition: Computes one elliptic-integral circular-filament response column per source and multiplies that column by its dimensionless linear weight without summing columns.
identity.model: vacuum axisymmetric ideal circular-filament Green relation
identity.geometry: point targets and circular source filaments in a cylindrical R-Z plane
identity.boundary: an axis source within 1e-12 m yields a zero column; nonfinite singular formula elements are replaced by zero
assumptions: The flux kernel is psi=R A_phi, not the complete linked flux 2*pi*psi.
Source weights are dimensionless multipliers, not currents or cell-area factors.
The caller performs any subsequent source-current contraction.

inputs.name: rz_pts
inputs.constraints: Finite with nonnegative target radii; an empty target list must retain the two-column shape.

inputs.name: source_rzw
inputs.constraints: Finite with nonnegative source radii; [] is accepted as an empty-source shorthand.

outputs.name: gpsi
outputs.description: Weighted psi=R A_phi response for each target and source pair.
outputs.constraints: Nonfinite formula values become zero; axis-source columns are zero; no 2*pi factor is applied.

outputs.name: gBR
outputs.description: Weighted radial-field response for each target and source pair.
outputs.constraints: Nonfinite formula values become zero; axis-source columns are zero.

outputs.name: gBZ
outputs.description: Weighted axial-field response for each target and source pair.
outputs.constraints: Nonfinite formula values become zero; axis targets may retain the analytic finite limit.

preconditions: Finite SI cylindrical coordinates with nonnegative target and source radii.
Weights represent dimensionless per-source linear multipliers.
supported: Independent Green response columns for ideal circular sources and arbitrary finite target lists.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong target/source row shape, nonfinite coordinates or weights, or negative cylindrical radii.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: SciPy elliptic-function errors propagate; nonfinite evaluated formula elements follow the maintained zero convention.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this operator has no solver iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No validation-time partial result; per-element nonfinite formula values are replaced with zero.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel implementation with internal source-derived development evidence; this document does not assert expert scientific approval of the current version.

example.description: Compare one source response with a changed weight and an empty source list.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field.dense_axisymmetric_green import dense_axisymmetric_green_response
targets = [[0.0, -0.1], [0.2, 0.15]]
unit = dense_axisymmetric_green_response(targets, [[0.35, -0.1, 1.0]])
weighted = dense_axisymmetric_green_response(targets, [[0.35, -0.1, -2.5]])
empty = dense_axisymmetric_green_response(targets, [])
for name in ('gpsi', 'gBR', 'gBZ'):
    assert unit[name].shape == (2, 1)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(weighted[name], -2.5 * unit[name])
    assert empty[name].shape == (2, 0)
example.expected: Three two-by-one weighted Green response matrices and zero-column matrices for the empty source set.

scope: Columnwise equality with the separately maintained circular-filament flux and field kernel.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Validated for the maintained ideal-filament Green columns and tested axis/weight cases; historical candidate evidence does not establish complete source-project closure or expert approval.
known_limitations: Singular formula elements are zeroed, not resolved physically.
The result preserves separate source columns and does not sum them.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
